summary: The public results (unit-defect classification, attainment, the three uniformizer/normalized-valuation bridges, natCastValuation_ne_zero_iff_ringChar_eq) have no existing counterpart in Mathlib or TauCeti. But the proofs contain verbatim in-diff clones and re-derive the fact v_K(2)=e three different ways instead of once, plus some plumbing that located lemmas already provide.
